_gate_note: 2026-07-31: 'custom-field-gate' fired on all four Production History fields and on Record Type, and did NOT prevent scoreboard B26 (a custom field built for a classification ClickUp has a native task type for). _unfired_note: 2026-08-10: THREE tools sat at their prior counts through a session that needed all three, and the flat number is the only record. 'doc-rot-sweep' stayed at 2 while the session hand-found FOUR instances of its Test A (phantom remediation) — a note claiming work was pending that had already shipped. 'session-board.md' was never written to across ~15 writes in two repos (scoreboard B22 count 3), and the board turned out to be 31KB and unwritable anyway, so an unused gate and a broken gate were indistinguishable. 'memory-rotation' stayed at 4 while two bundles and one queue sat over cap. A tool's count going UP proves it ran; a count staying FLAT proves nothing on its own, which is why these get named here rather than left to arithmetic.
